text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: No matter how many times I search, no one is talking about Machan. No one at all...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph.
Chan-Me needs to try even harder.
choice_data_list: I think you're working hard enough as it is.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
choice_data_list: You won't always see results right away.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Mmm... that's true.
Even the most popular mascot characters
had their humble beginnings.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"In the next race,
I'll show everyone Chan-chan's grand comeback."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Machan is even prepared
to cut back on her merch research time.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Being forgotten by everyone... would be unbearable.
